integrity.scientific_claim: Sharp asymptotic ergotropy growth \(\lim_{n\to\infty}\mathcal W_n/(\omega\sqrt{n\log n})=1/2\) in the cold collective-decay model.

scientific_limitations: Initial state I/2^n; exactly zero-temperature collective Lindblad emission; strictly positive common decay rate; noninteracting identical qubits.
All global unitaries allowed in ergotropy; extraction cost, finite relaxation time and individual dissipation excluded.
The sharp coefficient is asymptotic; slow finite-n convergence is expected; no statement for finite bath temperature.
title: A sharp \(\sqrt{n\log n}\) ergotropy law for cold collective decay
